name: Copper electrification demand
description: Long-cycle copper demand from grid investment and electrification.
why_it_matters: Copper supply growth can be slow because permitting and capital intensity constrain new mines.
current_affairs: Grid reliability and data-center power needs support copper intensity discussions.

name: Uranium and nuclear restart
description: Reactor life extensions, new-build announcements, and uranium contracting cycles.
why_it_matters: Utility contracting and mine restart timing may shape uranium market balance.
current_affairs: Government support for nuclear reliability has increased attention on fuel-cycle security.
thesis_notes: Separate structural nuclear support from commodity volatility.

name: Gold as safe-haven asset
description: Gold demand from central banks, real rates, currency risk, and uncertainty.
why_it_matters: Gold miners and royalty companies can have operating leverage to gold prices.
current_affairs: Central-bank buying remains a key precious metals discussion point.
thesis_notes: Compare miner operating risk with royalty exposure quality.

name: Royalty/streaming business model
description: Asset-light exposure to mine production and exploration optionality.
why_it_matters: The model may offer diversified commodity exposure with lower direct operating cost risk.
current_affairs: Higher capital costs can make streaming finance relevant.
thesis_notes: Build a checklist for stream terms and operator quality.
